_README: Hand-verified {leaderboard key -> substrate key} rescues for Group G.
Keys and values are match_key() output: org prefix and punctuation stripped.
Populated ONCE from `--discover-aliases` proposals; every entry below was
read and confirmed to be the same weights under a different spelling.
Exact match always wins, so an entry here can never override a real hit.
REJECTED proposals are recorded so the next person does not re-litigate them.
